description: This Java class defines configuration properties for establishing a Hotrod connection to a remote Infinispan cache, including methods to generate configuration builders and set SASL and cluster connection properties.

classes.name: InfinispanRemoteConfigurationProperties
classes.description: Configuration class for Infinispan Hotrod connection, extending core ConfigurationProperties to add specific connection setup capabilities.

methods.name: getConfigurationBuilder
methods.description: Creates and returns a ConfigurationBuilder instance initialized with current properties for setting up a cache.

methods.name: setSaslProperties
methods.description: Configures authentication properties related to SASL by mapping provided key-value pairs to configuration property keys.

methods.name: setCluster
methods.description: Sets cluster-related configuration properties based on provided key-value pairs.
